name: Luma AI API
description: Generates video with Luma's Ray 2 models and images with Photon through the Dream Machine API, with keyframes, extend, reframe, and modify, for apps using REST, Python, or JS SDKs.

skills.name: Ray 2 Video Generation
skills.description: Generates video from a text prompt or from start and end keyframes with Ray 2 or Ray 2 Flash, with loop and aspect ratio options.

skills.name: Extend and Interpolate
skills.description: Extends a generated video forward or in reverse, or interpolates between two videos.

skills.name: Photon Image Generation
skills.description: Generates images with Photon or Photon Flash, guided by image, style, or character references.

skills.name: Modify Video
skills.description: Applies style transfer and prompt-based edits to an existing video.

skills.name: Reframe
skills.description: Changes the aspect ratio of an existing image or video generation by its ID.
